verdict.rationale: Grok Bot is described as letting users 'hand real work to AI teammates on a persistent cloud computer,' implying some background/autonomous execution, but there's no documented scheduling, triggers, or cron-like automation setup, and no independent hands-on account of it running unattended. Community feedback also flags real weaknesses in agentic tool-calling reliability, which undercuts confidence in autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: explicit automation/scheduling docs, trigger-based workflows, and independent verification that tasks actually run unattended successfully.
